## About
Paramount Social & Poker Club is a poker room on Northwest Fwy in Houston, built around tournaments, the cash game and the people who sit down to play.
Players have given us a 4.7 rating from 135 Google reviews. One reviewer described a laid back atmosphere, and another called it a friendly, fun, family atmosphere.
Come by, take a seat and play a few hands.

## Services
- Tournaments: Regular tournaments for players who like a set structure.
- Cash game: A cash game for players who prefer to play outside the tournament format.

## FAQ
Q: Is there a cash game as well as tournaments?
A: Yes. We run tournaments and a cash game.

Q: I haven't played in years. Is that okay?
A: Yes. One reviewer came back after a decade away from the game and said everyone made them feel welcome and comfortable.

Q: Where are you located?
A: We're at 13153 Northwest Fwy, Houston, TX 77040.

## What customers say
- "First time playing after a decade. Was a little skeptical at first but I am glad I gave them the benefit of the doubt. The fellow players were nice and courteous too. Over all everyone made me feel very welcome and comfortable which was really nice. Ended up splitting both games with final few players for pretty much highest stack  which was also a sweet feeling.  I just wished that the point leader board for top 25 was displayed at all times live for everyone to see which would certainly get me motivated to come back for more to try to make it to the list."
